title: Exploring Attention Sinks in Text-to-Image Transformers from Diffusion and Autoregressive Models
title_zh: 从扩散模型与自回归模型视角探索文本到图像Transformer中的注意力“汇”

paragraphs.en: 本文从扩散模型与自回归模型视角探讨文本到图像Transformer中的注意力“汇”，发现其在不同模型中表现出不同模式，并对其功能性影响进行了研究。 Attention sinks are tokens or positions that consistently receive disproportionate attention mass, often beyond what their semantic content would suggest. Despite extensive study in large language models, their behavior and functional relevance in text-to-image (T2I) Transformers remain largely unexplored. To fill this gap and better understand how text-to-image Transformers allocate and route attention, we explore this phenomenon of text-to-image transformers across bidirectional diffusion models and causal autoregressive models. Specifically, we explore whether attention sinks exist, where they emerge, and how they functionally influence generation. Through systematic attention analysis and targeted interventions, we identify that attention sinks emerge in both bidirectional diffusion and autoregressive models but exhibit distinct patterns. The autoregressive model concentrates attention on the first and global-scale tokens, whereas the bidirectional models develop sinks near modality boundaries, within text regions, and at spatial corners. Moreover, these patterns vary across generation stages and are localized to a sparse subset of layers and heads. To assess their functional relevance, we perturb sink-related heads and token positions. It turns out that perturbing sink-ranked heads produces larger average changes than non-sink comparisons, while some sink-position perturbations have limited effects on bidirectional model scores. We further introduce register tokens to redistribute attention sinks and find that several configurations preserve or modestly improve generation performance. Overall, attention sinks are architecture-, inference-stage-, and component-dependent phenomena, providing a basis for mechanistic analysis and principled attention design in text-to-image transformers.
paragraphs.zh: 本文从扩散模型与自回归模型的视角探讨了文本到图像Transformer中的注意力“汇”，发现其在不同模型中表现出不同模式，并对其功能性影响进行了研究。注意力汇是指那些持续获得不成比例注意力权重的词元或位置，这种权重通常超出了其语义内容所应得的程度。 尽管大型语言模型已得到广泛研究，但它们在文本到图像（T2I）Transformer中的行为及功能相关性仍基本未被探索。 为了填补这一空白并更好地理解文本到图像Transformer如何分配和引导注意力，我们从双向扩散模型和因果自回归模型两个角度探讨了文本到图像Transformer中的这一现象。 具体而言，我们探究了注意力汇是否存在、它们出现在何处，以及它们在功能上如何影响生成过程。 通过系统性的注意力分析和有针对性的干预，我们发现注意力汇在双向扩散模型和自回归模型中都会出现，但表现出不同的模式。 自回归模型将注意力集中在首个词元和全局尺度的词元上，而双向模型则在模态边界附近、文本区域内部以及空间角落处形成了注意力汇。 此外，这些模式在不同生成阶段存在差异，并且仅局限于少数几层和注意力头中。 为了评估其功能相关性，我们对与注意力汇相关的注意力头和词元位置进行了扰动。 结果表明，对注意力汇排名靠前的注意力头进行扰动所产生的平均变化量大于非汇相关比较，而某些注意力汇位置的扰动对双向模型得分的影响有限。 我们进一步引入了寄存器词元来重新分配注意力汇，并发现某些配置能够保持或适度提升生成性能。 总体而言，注意力汇是一种依赖于架构、推理阶段和组件的现象，这为文本到图像Transformer的机制分析和有原则的注意力设计提供了基础。
